The '''BAX-7 landspeeder''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] craft that was manufactured by [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]],<ref name="BHC" /> headquartered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="MandalMotors">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> The [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] had a small, curved windscreen that extended halfway toward the rear of the vehicle and left the rest of the passenger area open. The body of the speeder was curved, with a downward-pointing nose and an upward-pointing rear portion. At least one speeder of the BAX-7 model was [[Color/Legends|brown]]. The BAX-7's interior featured seating for four individuals, two in front and two in the rear of the craft, while the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] operated the landspeeder from the front right-hand seat.<ref name="BHC" />

At some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' includes an [[in-universe]] copy of the ''[[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]''. The included edition of the Handbook was published at some point following the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and is annotated by [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], whose [[Death/Legends|death]] is depicted in {{Film|IV}}. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the formation of the Empire and the events of ''A New Hope'' in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], respectively, the included edition of the Bounty Hunters' Guild Handbook must have been published at some point between those two dates.</ref> the veteran [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Chentu Chek]] included an image of a brown BAX-7 in the "Tools of the Trade," a chapter which they contributed to the ''[[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]''.<ref name="BHC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The BAX-7 landspeeder was featured in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', a reference book released in [[2013]] and co-written by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Ryder Windham]], and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="BHC" />
